info.description:
The HTTP API a game talks to: accounts, leaderboards, cloud saves, inventory, a priced catalogue, shared assets, remote config, live events, replays and headless test runs.

This document is GENERATED from the same table the server routes from, and a test compares it to the routes Drogon actually registered. It cannot describe an endpoint that does not exist, and an endpoint cannot exist without appearing here.
info.title: Game Backend-as-a-Service
